units.source_text: 以後，縱然有巨大的悲傷降臨於我也無妨，就算內心焦慮地渴望粗野的歡樂也無妨，此刻我的快樂只是與客人漫無邊際地閒聊，喝客人請我喝的酒。

en.t: From then on, it did not matter if some great sorrow came upon me later, or if my heart anxiously craved a rough sort of pleasure; my only happiness at that moment was chatting aimlessly with customers and drinking the liquor they bought me.

units.source_text: 來到京橋之後，這種無聊的生活持續了將近一年。

en.t: After I came to Kyobashi, this pointless life continued for nearly a year.

units.source_text: 我的漫畫不光刊登在兒童雜誌上，也刊登在車站內的售貨店裡擺放的雜誌上。

en.t: My cartoons began appearing not only in children's magazines, but also in magazines displayed at the sales kiosks inside stations.

units.source_text: 我以「上司幾太」（與情死未遂的發音相同）這個惡搞的筆名，畫了一些下流的裸體畫，還在當中插入一些《魯拜集》裡的詩句。

en.t: Under the joke pen name Joshi Ikuta, which sounds the same as a failed double suicide, I drew vulgar nude pictures and inserted lines from the Rubaiyat into them.

units.source_text: 停止徒勞的祈禱扔掉讓人落淚的一切吧來，乾杯！

en.t: Stop those useless prayers, throw away everything that brings tears to your eyes. Come on, cheers!
